panels.title: $symbol - trading hours only, gaps between sessions removed
panels.description: The x-axis is trading time, not wall-clock: overnight and weekend gaps are collapsed so sessions sit side by side. The true timestamp is in the tooltip as IST. One session selected marks all three windows; several marks only the best of each.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_date FROM v_intraday_candles
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT session_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY session_date) - 1              AS idx,
         strftime('%s', session_date || ' 09:15:00') - 19800        AS open_epoch
  FROM picked
),
scope AS (SELECT MIN(open_epoch) AS base, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM ordered),
-- One session: show all three windows. Several: only the best of each, or the
-- chart becomes unreadable.
depth AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT sessions FROM scope) = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END AS max_rank)
SELECT (SELECT base FROM scope) + (o.idx * 376 + (c.ts_epoch - o.open_epoch) / 60) * 60 AS time,
       c.open, c.high, c.low, c.close,
       datetime(c.ts_epoch, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AS "IST",
       e.entry_price AS "Window entry",
       x.exit_price  AS "Window exit",
       b.price       AS "Your buy",
       s.price       AS "Your sell"
FROM v_intraday_candles c
JOIN ordered o ON o.session_date = c.session_date
LEFT JOIN v_opportunity_markers e
       ON e.symbol = c.symbol AND e.entry_ts = c.ts_epoch
      AND e.detector_version = '$detector' AND e.rank <= (SELECT max_rank FROM depth)
LEFT JOIN v_opportunity_markers x
       ON x.symbol = c.symbol AND x.exit_ts = c.ts_epoch
      AND x.detector_version = '$detector' AND x.rank <= (SELECT max_rank FROM depth)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT symbol, ts_epoch / 60 * 60 AS minute, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'BUY' GROUP BY symbol, minute) b
       ON b.symbol = c.symbol AND b.minute = c.ts_epoch
LEFT JOIN (SELECT symbol, ts_epoch / 60 * 60 AS minute, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'SELL' GROUP BY symbol, minute) s
       ON s.symbol = c.symbol AND s.minute = c.ts_epoch
WHERE c.symbol = '$symbol' AND c.session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
ORDER BY time

panels.title: $symbol - windows found in the selected sessions
panels.description: What was available, not what you took. Ranked by gain; the windows never overlap, so these are three distinct opportunities.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT session_date                             AS "Session",
       rank                                     AS "#",
       time(entry_ts,'unixepoch','+5 hours','+30 minutes')                     AS "Entry",
       time(exit_ts,'unixepoch','+5 hours','+30 minutes')                      AS "Exit",
       entry_price                              AS "Buy at",
       exit_price                               AS "Sell at",
       ROUND(gain_pct, 2)                       AS "Gain %",
       duration_minutes                         AS "Held (min)"
FROM v_opportunity_markers
WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
  AND detector_version = '$detector'
ORDER BY session_date DESC, rank

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT m.session_date AS "Date",
       time(m.ts_epoch, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AS "Time (IST)",
       m.side       AS "Side",
       m.product    AS "Product",
       m.quantity   AS "Qty",
       m.price      AS "Price",
       m.bet_amount AS "Bet amount",
       COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(r.reason_code, ', '), '-') AS "Reason"
FROM v_trade_markers m
LEFT JOIN trade t ON t.executed_ts = m.ts_epoch
LEFT JOIN trade_reason r ON r.trade_id = t.id
WHERE m.symbol = '$symbol' AND m.session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
GROUP BY m.ts_epoch, m.side, m.product, m.quantity, m.price, m.bet_amount, m.session_date
ORDER BY m.ts_epoch DESC
LIMIT 300

panels.title: $symbol - weekly candles, with the calls you took

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT w.ts_epoch AS time,
       w.open  AS open,
       w.high  AS high,
       w.low   AS low,
       w.close AS close,
       b.price AS "Buy",
       s.price AS "Sell"
FROM v_weekly_candles w
LEFT JOIN (SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) AS week, symbol, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'BUY' GROUP BY week, symbol) b
       ON b.week = w.week AND b.symbol = w.symbol
LEFT JOIN (SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) AS week, symbol, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'SELL' GROUP BY week, symbol) s
       ON s.week = w.week AND s.symbol = w.symbol
WHERE w.symbol = '$symbol'
ORDER BY w.session_date
